verdict.rationale: Resend's llms.txt says marketing users can "build recurring flows with automations". The broadcast API supports scheduling a one-off send for later, using natural language or ISO 8601. This is email-scoped scheduling only, and the recurring-automation claim is a single thin mention with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documented recurrence or cron-style scheduling, automation API/CLI/MCP control for AI-native use, general-purpose job or workflow scheduling beyond email, and independent hands-on corroboration.
